Winchester Mystery House
Code Update 11/12/26
You’ve explored every room in the mansion… now it’s time to face the spirit haunting it all. The Encounter Wizard Mode has arrived, bringing your first direct confrontation with Henry! Just as construction on Sarah’s sprawling estate was never quite complete, we’re still adding enhancements and fixes
to the Winchester Mystery House® pinball machine code!
Encounter
Wizard Mode
Henry’s presence fills the mansion. Use the action button to charge your flippers and shoot the ramps to build your jackpot, but block the objects he hurls at you or lose every flip you’ve gathered. Once your flips run dry and the ball slips away, Henry fully materializes. Hit the blue shots, avoid his red ones, and strike quickly before he seizes control!

Winchester Mystery House Code Update 10/1/26
All rooms are now available for tours! With the Callroom and the Witch’s Cap now open, every room in the Winchester Mystery House is finally unlocked. But don’t get too comfortable… just as construction on Sarah’s sprawling estate was never quite complete, we’re always adding enhancements and fixes to the
Winchester Mystery House® pinball machine code!
The Callroom
“The Unfinished Request”
The Callroom annunciator rings for the first time since Sarah’s passing, and it’s calling from her bedroom. The spirit of Maura Brisby, head housekeeper, insists you answer the call. Follow the lit path from room to room, but beware…Is it a call for help, or another one of Henry’s traps?
The Witch’s Cap
“The Circle of Echoes”
A spirit board sits at the center of the room, beckoning you to commune with the spirits present, eager to speak within the domed room. Follow their broken whispers to find the treasures within and appease the spirits.

sections.Code Update Notes, posted 2026-05-01: WM:
Code Update 4/29/26
The angry spirits have arrived in the second major code update for Winchester Mystery House® Pinball! This huge update features the inclusion of Echoes Wizard Mode, the emergence of Angry Spirits, and the Daisy Bedroom! And just as construction on Sarah’s sprawling estate was never quite complete, we’re always adding enhancements and fixes to the Winchester Mystery House® pinball machine code!
ECHOES WIZARD MODE
Collect 3 Mementos to qualify and experience a major earthquake that destroys the Winchester Mystery House tower. Clyde needs backup in the basement, and then it’s a mad dash to the Grand Ballroom to expel what the earthquake let in.
ANGRY SPIRITS
Fail a mode and you’ve got company, unleashing an angry spirit into the house. Beware if you cross paths… or let too many into the house! If you’re doing a little too well for their liking, then the angry spirits may ambush you! Watch out!
THE DAISY BEDROOM:
THE SHATTERED THRESHOLD
Playable only after the Echoes Wizard Mode.
Beware! The earthquake cracked the walls and the spirits know it!
Build a salt barrier fast to keep them out!
